title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The bakery name is missing; no dark navy lettering is visible.
The image displays a full tan/gold square surrounding the artwork rather than a visibly clean transparent background.
The crescent is extremely faint and partially erased, with indistinct edges and pale residual marks.

judge.summary: The output is a tan square with a barely visible crescent and no readable bakery name, making it unusable as the requested logo.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: No name or navy lettering is visible.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: A faint crescent-like shape is visible, but the name beneath it is absent.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The supplied output visibly has a tan/gold rectangular field surrounding the crescent rather than a clean cutout.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The lettering is entirely absent, and the crescent is heavily faded with incomplete-looking edges and pale remnants.
